parent_dtype_role: capacity and coordinate unit; not an inherited access interpretation
view_default_part: whole parent slot as a conservative occupancy/conflict envelope; does not imply every byte is read or written

decisions.recommendation: Delete view.dtype entirely. Preserve numeric formats and necessary local/encoded representations in existing value, producer-action or realization definitions; cancel parent-dtype inheritance for view access.

Permit whole-region sequential reuse without a precise part only when existing ordering retires all conflicting accesses. Keep meaningful partial overlap/coexistence constraints; do not add a full-group wait merely to omit a field.
Keep MLA P column[32,64), row ownership and source limitations in this proposed rewrite. Earlier blanket whole-slot simplification was withdrawn after directed counterexample review.
Retain per-view slot mappings. Do not add a parent default plus per-view overrides; report 01 independently prefers that alternative and its opinion remains visible.
Keep one optional view map. Ordinary independent regions may remain flat storage entries; do not replace actual overlap with an underspecified shared_with label or lose distinct copies.
Keep explicit capacity and materialization/representation constraints. Ti has a 5120-byte packed footprint although its dense logical BF16 matrix would be 8192 bytes.
